yoy_growth.description: Year-over-year growth percentage for a base measure.
yoy_growth.template: DIVIDE([{{base_measure}}] - CALCULATE([{{base_measure}}], DATEADD('Date'[Date], -1, YEAR)), CALCULATE([{{base_measure}}], DATEADD('Date'[Date], -1, YEAR)))

rolling_12m.description: Rolling 12-month total for a base measure using the Date table.

time_intelligence.name: Time Intelligence
time_intelligence.description: Standard time-intelligence calculation items built on SELECTEDMEASURE().

items.name: YoY %
items.expression: DIVIDE(SELECTEDMEASURE() - CALCULATE(SELECTEDMEASURE(), DATEADD('Date'[Date], -1, YEAR)), CALCULATE(SELECTEDMEASURE(), DATEADD('Date'[Date], -1, YEAR)))
